title: Track currently-playing media in UI state and render from it
trigger: A list of playable media items where the play button should swap to pause and the row should highlight while playing
principle: Don't mutate DOM icons/classes directly inside the play handler. Store `currentlyPlayingId` (and the active `HTMLAudioElement`) in the panel's state, then call the same render function with the updated state. The render function derives `isPlaying = currentlyPlayingId === item.id` and sets the icon, ARIA label, and highlight class from that state. This keeps the UI a pure function of state and makes pause/ended/error cleanup a single render call.

cases.context: Popup dictionary Audio tab — clicking a Forvo row should play, show pause icon, and highlight the row; clicking again pauses

applyFor: Audio/tts item lists with play/pause toggle
Video thumbnail grids with a playing preview
Any media list where the active item needs visual feedback
